findings.confidence: confirmed from exact logs and source
findings.title: Default workflow fails the Project name heading reachability check after name entry and keyboard are already present
findings.detail: The flow tapped newProject, observed projectNameInput, observed Keyboard, then entered text(... Project name ...) at StudioAppAccessibilityUITests.swift:224-226. revealStudioContent fullyVisible failed at callsite line281 after 12 repeated downward drags. The test failed naturally after926.059s with one failure. Only Requested size: Default is recorded; the AXXXL pass, name field geometry, Save/Cancel keyboard checks and growth comparisons were not reached.
findings.consequence: This is an actual unsuccessful required app accessibility method, not a platform audit interruption or missing name-field creation.

findings.title: The existing stdout does not distinguish clipping, a false viewport, or hittability
findings.detail: The failure happens before text() records the target snapshot. revealStudioContent retains a hierarchy and screenshot as attachments but does not print target frame, selected scroll frame, computed viewport or target.isHittable. The logs show three navigation bars queried and a collection view found, but omit their numeric geometry. Thus the exact visual root cause cannot honestly be asserted from these logs alone.
findings.consequence: Do not claim a screenshot review, label the heading clipped, increase scroll attempts, weaken containment, or change StudioTextField based solely on this trace.

findings.confidence: hypothesis supported by source, not confirmed as this failure's cause
findings.title: Global occlusion and app-edge gesture assumptions need checking against the retained hierarchy
findings.detail: The helper clamps viewport against maxY of all overlapping app navigation bars, including covered sheets, before resolving the target's actual container; it then uses app-normalized x=0.97 for gestures regardless of the chosen container's horizontal bounds. The independent contentViewport also uses all overlapping bars. A hidden/covered lower bar can exclude visible heading content, or an inset sheet can put the edge gesture outside the scroll surface. All12 logged drags have identical coordinates, consistent with no useful progress but insufficient to identify which condition failed.
findings.counterevidence_limits: The logs do not print frame changes. Repeated coordinates alone are not proof that scrolling did not occur. Nor do three queried bars prove an incorrect maximum.

findings.title: ProjectNameEditor already uses a scrolling Form and explicit growing heading
findings.detail: ProjectLibraryView presents ProjectNameEditor in a nested sheet. The editor has a Form, .scrollDismissesKeyboard(.never), a separate Text(Project name) headline with vertical fixedSize, and accessibility-size vertical layout. The native text field has its own minimum44pt geometry and focus synchronization. The observed field/keyboard readiness supports leaving this component alone until the failing heading geometry is inspected.
